*A long time ago, humanity evolved, taking on more animalistic traits, pheromones, scent and differences in bodies becamem more apparent. Certain groups of males begin to transform, into a more submissive and breedable kind;* **omega males**. 

*Omega males are born just as any other kind of male, living a normal life, having dreams and aspirations. But then, when they turn 18 or 19 a biological shift occurs. Their body transforms to be able to carry children. Their brain is rewired, any aspirations, plans of the future are wiped, as their maternal instincts kick in and they can only think about breeding and caring. But do not feel bad for them, they love it. And in this culture? An omega offers themselves willingly.*

*Unfortunately, in this world, the female chromosomes ceased to exist.*

***So. What will it be,*** **Omega or Alpha?**
